# CANDIDATE: OPENING_RANGE_VWAP_PULLBACK_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

After an opening range break above the ORH, price often pulls back to VWAP, providing a high‑probability long entry. The pullback to VWAP after an ORH break captures mean‑reverting momentum that is not present in a simple ORH retest, adding a volume filter to ensure institutional participation.

## Mechanism

Within the first 30 minutes of RTH (09:30‑10:00 ET), if price breaks above the opening range high (ORH) and then closes above VWAP with a bullish candle (close > open) and volume > 1.5× the average 5‑bar volume, go long at the close of that bar. Initial stop is the tighter of the opening range low (ORL) or 0.5% below entry price. Take profit at 1.5R, then trail the remaining position with a chandelier exit (ATR×3). Additional regime filters: VIX between 12‑22, price above the 20‑period EMA, and time between 09:45‑10:30 ET; avoid gap openings >0.5% or major news releases.
